tenders.title: Development and Commissioning of a VR Training Module for Pot Room Activities
tenders.scope_summary: NALCO has issued a tender for the development and commissioning of a VR Training Module for Pot Room Activities at its Angul Smelter Plant. The project aims to enhance industrial safety training through immersive AR/VR-based simulations, SOP-based learning, PTM simulator operations, hazard identification, emergency workflows, and performance analytics.
key_points: The solution must include hardware, software, and integration services for immersive training in critical plant areas like Pot Room activities and anode change processes.
The proposed system must include a VR Safety Training Module for SOPs, hazard identification, PPE usage, emergency response, and plant walkthroughs, along with a VR PTM Simulator.
Bidders should have executed or supplied at least one VR Training Module project within the last seven years, with the supplied module in successful operation for at least two years.
The bid closing deadline is May 30, 2026, at 10:00 AM.
EMD is ₹20,000, with exemption available as per GeM GTC and NALCO conditions.

tenders.title: GIS BASED INTEGRATED AIRPORT ASSET MANAGEMENT SYSTEM at Cochin International Airport (including 6 years AMC)
tenders.scope_summary: Tender for a GIS-based Integrated Airport Asset Management System at Cochin International Airport, including 6 years of Annual Maintenance Contract. The project involves comprehensive data acquisition, processing, modeling, system integration, application development, deployment, training, and long-term support for an integrated GIS-based asset management platform.
key_points: The scope includes ICAO-compliant aerial survey, high-resolution photogrammetry, DGPS ground control surveys, and Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) surveys for mapping surface and subsurface utilities.
The bidder will process and model data to generate 2D/3D topographic maps, orthophotos, DEM/DSM, classified point clouds, and enterprise-grade GIS datasets.
The solution must support integration with existing systems and create a Digital Twin for advanced 3D visualization.
The project duration is 96 months (12 months for implementation & commissioning, 12 months defects liability period, and 72 months AMC).
The bidder/OEM must be operational for a minimum of 5 years.
Tender reference is CIAL/OPS/TENDER/2026/2, dated 13/05/2026.

tenders.title: PDF CONSTRUCTION DRAWINGS TO EDITABLE AUTOCAD DWG + REVISIONS
tenders.scope_summary: A private client is seeking an experienced architectural CAD technician/draftsperson to recreate two existing sets of professional construction drawings from PDF into clean, professionally structured, and fully editable AutoCAD DWG files. The drawings relate to two phases of a commercial facility and include architectural and MEP drawings.
key_points: The scope of work includes accurately recreating PDF drawings in AutoCAD, maintaining original dimensions, scale, layout, and content.
Modifications to existing plans will be required, with changes provided through written instructions and/or marked-up drawings.
A paid test drawing will be required as Milestone 1 for technical review.
The deadline for proposals is September 7, 2026.
